title: Unbounded termwise injective K-injective models
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian category with its derived category. Every object M of D(C) is isomorphic to Q(I) for a K-injective cochain complex I all of whose terms are injective. The category and the complexes are those of [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] and [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Tag 079P (theorem-K-injective-embedding-grothendieck), using lemma-functorial-injective; source KInjectiveResolution.lean weak factorization system

proof.text: Choose a complex representing M. Factor its map to zero by the monomorphic-quasi-isomorphism weak factorization system in the source KInjectiveResolution module underlying [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-functorial-existence]. The intermediate I is K-injective and I to zero has the right lifting property.

Apply [lem-pur-kinjective-functorial-injective] to I. Its monomorphic quasi-isomorphism j:I to N(I) lifts against I to zero, giving a retraction N(I) to I. In degree n, j factors through an injective J; compose the second factor with the retraction. Thus I^n is a retract of J, hence injective. Localize the original quasi-isomorphism to obtain Q(I) isomorphic to M.
